title: Velocity from selector
description: Essential: States that the velocity after the velocity selector is v = E/B, derived from force balance.

title: Charge-to-mass ratio
description: Essential: Correctly gives the charge-to-mass ratio as q/m = 2E/((R1+R2)B^2) from magnetic analyzer analysis.

title: Electric-only deflection
description: Essential: For part (2), gives the correct implantation coordinates as (3L²/(R1+R2), 0).

title: Magnetic-only deflection
description: Essential: For part (3), gives the correct implantation coordinates as (0, 3L²/(R1+R2)).

title: Combined fields deflection
description: Essential: For part (4), gives the correct implantation coordinates as (3L²/(R1+R2), 3L²/(R1+R2)).

title: Small-angle approximations
description: Important: Applies the given small-angle approximations (sin α ≈ α, etc.) correctly in deflection calculations.

title: Deflection geometry
description: Important: Correctly calculates the total deflection distance (e.g., 3L²/(R1+R2)) by summing displacement inside and after the field region.

title: Superposition principle
description: Important: For part (4), justifies the final position by superposition of independent electric (x) and magnetic (y) deflections.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Assigns deflection to the wrong coordinate axis (e.g., swaps x and y for electric vs. magnetic cases).

title: Incorrect radius
description: Pitfall: Uses R1 or R2 alone instead of the average radius (R1+R2)/2 for the magnetic analyzer.
